name: trustgraph
description: Shared Web-of-Trust model for the Digital Trust Protocol: library, conformance corpus, resolver client, telemetry UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dtp/trust-graph -w @dtp/trust-protocol -w @dtp/telemetry-ui && npm run build -w @dtp/trust-query -w @dtp/relay-sync && npm run build -w @dtp/resolver-client -w @dtp/conformance
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
